universe_basis: Current Nifty 500 constituent snapshot applied retrospectively. This is not point-in-time historical index membership and must not be used for survivorship-bias-free backtesting.
historical_fno_membership: unknown; daily contract observations are recorded where present, but today's F&O list is not projected backward
stock_specific_attribution_boundary: Cash/delivery and derivatives observations describe market activity; they do not identify FII/FPI ownership or participant-by-stock positions.
